race.description: Coastline Mini Garage Pink Ribbon Cup Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: Looks a competitive affair. DON'TCHA THINK (2) has a handy record over this distance range with two wins and three placings from nine attempts and will be ready to peak now third run back from the break. Should get a gun run in transit from gate four and is sure to be right there at the business end. NIGHTCAPPED (6) loves this circuit with three wins and two placings from just six spins and must be respected out of the Bruce yard. Has to be included. ITALIAN DANCER (3) hasn't put a hoof wrong with back-to-back wins this preparation and gets some weight off from the inside marble. Top-three commodity. The well-related WARNA (10) (half to G2 winner Count De Rupee) boasts a win over this track and trip and is usually about the money. In the mix. ITALIAN RIVIERA (1) next in line with the 3kg claim.
